## 2. Two pages list all three, newest first

SDK `GET /plugins/elevation/operations?limit=2` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "capability": "elevation.lookup",
      "created_at": "<time>",
      "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
      "error": null,
      "id": "<id-4>",
      "input": {
        "latitude": 42,
        "longitude": -71
      },
      "output": {
        "elevation": 100,
        "latitude": 42,
        "longitude": -71,
        "reference": "synthetic demonstration datum (zero is arbitrary, not surveyed terrain)",
        "units": "m"
      },
      "plugin_id": "elevation",
      "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
      "status": "completed",
      "submission_id": "<submission 3>"
    },
    {
      "capability": "elevation.lookup",
      "created_at": "<time>",
      "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
      "error": null,
      "id": "<id-3>",
      "input": {
        "latitude": 42.001,
        "longitude": -71
      },
      "output": {
        "elevation": 120,
        "latitude": 42.001,
        "longitude": -71,
        "reference": "synthetic demonstration datum (zero is arbitrary, not surveyed terrain)",
        "units": "m"
      },
      "plugin_id": "elevation",
      "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
      "status": "completed",
      "submission_id": "<submission 2>"
    }
  ],
  "next_cursor": "<cursor-1>"
}
```
